theorem T_43_2 {V : Type} [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] [Nonempty V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hn1 : (G.chromaticNumber.toNat : ℤ) ≥ 2 * (G.maxDegree : ℤ)) (hn2 : (G.edgeFinset.card : ℤ) ≤ 2 * (Fintype.card V : ℤ)) :
    (G.cliqueNum : ℤ) ≥ -3 * (Fintype.card V : ℤ) + (G.edgeFinset.card : ℤ) + 4
proof_ref:
by
  have s1 : 3 * (Fintype.card V : ℤ) - (G.edgeFinset.card : ℤ) + (G.cliqueNum : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by
    by_cases hc1 : (3 : ℤ) ≤ (G.chromaticNumber.toNat : ℤ)
    · -- 1*chi >= 3
      have s2 : (Fintype.card V : ℤ) - (G.chromaticNumber.toNat : ℤ) ≥ 0 := by
        have hw := chi_le_n_int G
        try push_cast at hw
        linarith [hw]
      have s3 : (G.chromaticNumber.toNat : ℤ) ≥ 3 := by have hcc := hc1; omega
      have s4 : (G.cliqueNum : ℤ) ≥ 1 := by
        have hw := omega_ge_one_int' G
        try push_cast at hw
        linarith [hw]
      have s5 : 2 * (Fintype.card V : ℤ) - (G.edgeFinset.card : ℤ) ≥ 0 := by linarith [hn2]
      have s6 : 3 * (Fintype.card V : ℤ) - (G.edgeFinset.card : ℤ) + (G.cliqueNum : ℤ) ≥ 4 := by linarith [s2, s3, s4, s5]
